`cbore_chamfer.step` is our original Apache-2.0 build123d control for #244, not the reporter’s file: a 30 × 30 × 5 plate, ⌀8 × 2 boss, ⌀3.3 through bore, ⌀5 × 2.25 counterbore and 0.25 × 45° mouth chamfer. Recipe: `make.py`; regenerate with `uv run --no-project --with build123d python -I make.py cbore_chamfer.step`. The committed STEP pins face numbering (cone 1; core hole faces 3,10); exporter versions may renumber regenerated faces.
